hero.headline: DC-Air<sup>®</sup> Wireless Intraoral X-Ray Sensor
hero.tagline:
True Wireless® direct conversion intraoral X-ray imaging.
Crystal clear images. No wire. No compromise.

overview.headline:
Freedom of movement.
No compromise on image.
overview.body1: DC-Air® — the Wireless Intraoral Sensor — combines Athlos Si-CMOS direct conversion technology with Bluetooth 5.0 wireless connectivity. The result is a True Wireless® intraoral sensor that delivers the sharpness of direct conversion, the comfort of phosphor plates, and the workflow speed of a corded system — without the cord.
overview.body2: The DC-Air® system includes the sensor, a magnetic docking station, and the complete Zero Profile® holder set — designed by doctors together with Athlos for accurate intraoral positioning and patient comfort.
overview.imageAlt: DC-Air® system — docking station and Zero Profile holder set

features.headline: Built for the clinic. Engineered for precision.

wireless.title: True Wireless® Workflow
wireless.body: No intraoral cable. Bluetooth 5.0 wireless link from sensor to docking station to PC. Sensor range up to 3 metres. Reduces patient discomfort and simplifies clinical workflow.

directConversion.title: Direct Conversion Imaging
directConversion.body: Si-CMOS direct conversion technology converts X-ray photons directly into signal — eliminating the scintillator step. The result: sharper detail, better contrast, and more consistent images.

zeroProfile.title: Zero Profile® Holders
zeroProfile.body: The purpose-designed Zero Profile® holder set includes Anterior, Posterior, Bitewing, Endodontic and Occlusal holders. Precisely aligns the sensor without relying on the cable for angulation — designed for patient comfort and repeatable positioning.

battery.title: Battery & Safety
battery.body: Up to 300 X-rays per charge. Integrated buffer memory stores one image temporarily. Dynamic self-calibration with every capture. Rechargeable Lithium-Ion battery. Magnetic docking for reliable recharging.

ip67.title: IP67 & Durability
ip67.body: Enhanced IP67 protection. Ultrasonic-bonded PPSU enclosure — a material with exceptional hydrolytic stability and impact resistance. Built for the demanding realities of daily clinical use.

software.title: Broad Software Compatibility
software.body: The DC-Air® TWAIN module integrates with Dentrix Ascend, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, Dexis, TigerView, Romexis, Acteon, Apteryx, XDR Radiology, and many more TWAIN-enabled imaging platforms.

video.headline: DC-Air® overview
video.body: A short overview of the DC-Air®, True Wireless® intraoral sensor — how it works, what makes it different, and what it delivers for the modern dental practice.

awards.headline: Award-winning technology.
awards.body: DC-Air® and the direct conversion technology behind it have been recognised by leading dental and healthcare industry awards programmes.

clinicians.headline: Evaluated by Clinicians Report.
clinicians.body: Clinicians Report is an independent dental product evaluation foundation trusted by practitioners worldwide. In 2022, DC-Air® was reviewed and highlighted across two dedicated CR evaluations — a First Look in January and a comparative assessment published in March.
clinicians.callout: In the March 2022 comparative evaluation, CR scientists and clinicians observed that DC-Air® radiographs showed improved clarity and subtle detail compared to conventional CMOS sensors — and described direct conversion technology as a significant advancement.

highlights.h1: High resolution and excellent dynamic range highlighted in the CR First Look evaluation.
highlights.h2: Wireless image transfer and processing observed at approximately 6–8 seconds — maintaining clinical workflow speed without a cable.
highlights.h3: Clinicians found the sensor easy to work with and more comfortable than conventional corded sensors.
highlights.h4: Featured in a dedicated March 2022 CR publication: “DC-Air®: Wireless Intraoral Sensor with Improved Image Quality.”

clinicians.footnote: Clinicians Report is published by CR Foundation, an independent non-profit dental product testing organisation. Evaluations referenced: CR First Look, January 2022; CR Comparative Evaluation, March 2022.
